name: AICommandCenter
description: AICommandCenter is the full-page AI workspace. In the idle state it shows the avatar, a welcome heading, quick chips, and a centered input card. Once a message is sent, it transitions to a scroll-pinned chat thread with user bubbles, loading indicators, AI response patterns (analytical, Q&A, actionable, contextual, awaiting-approval), and a feedback bar per response. Background transitions via gradient surface tokens.
intent: Full AI chat workspace with idle state, conversation thread, and response patterns. The complete AI Led command surface for agentic tasks and conversational flows.
